summary: Write the Sky Fragrances build specs in small chunked units (stall-resistant rerun)
logs: Writing 14 spec units in parallel, chunked appends

decisions: DECIMAL(10,2) UNSIGNED wins over 03-storefront-pages §1.4's 'unsigned integers in whole rupees' — that section should be amended; display helper still renders Rs. 4,950 with no decimals.

scent_families exists as a lookup TABLE alongside the contract's products.scent_family VARCHAR — route /scent/{slug} needs a slug, intro copy and SEO fields a bare string cannot carry; join is on the unique name, admin <select> keeps the vocabulary closed.
admin_sessions INCLUDED: stores sha256(session_id) as a session index only (PHP still holds the payload), enabling revoke-on-password-change and surviving Hostinger's /tmp session sweeps.
Notes pyramid stays three comma-separated VARCHAR(255) columns; one parse helper: array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(',', $v)), 'strlen'). No JSON column (MariaDB 10.4), no child table.

Soft-delete anything an order can point at (products, product_sizes, collections, scent_families, content_pages, admin_users, newsletter_subscribers, contact_messages); hard-delete the rest (product_images with file unlink, spam reviews, slug_redirects, quiz_*, security telemetry).
Slug rename collapses redirect chains to one hop and deletes the self-referential row on revert, so a reverted rename cannot create a 301 loop.

settings degrade through code-owned defaults in /includes/settings-defaults.php; NULL or '' never overrides a default, typed accessors fall back on failed casts, missing key returns empty and never throws.
product_sizes.stock is a signed INT deliberately so an oversell fails loudly in one guarded place instead of clamping at unsigned zero.
Opportunistic purges (1-in-50 request) for admin_login_attempts/admin_sessions/activity_log instead of cron, which the non-developer owner will not configure.
FULLTEXT on products for /search with a LIKE fallback under the 4-char token minimum; portable to both MySQL 8 and MariaDB 10.4.
Money is DECIMAL(10,2) — explicitly supersedes 03-storefront-pages.md §1.4 ("unsigned integers in whole rupees"); the Rs. 4,950 display rule still stands
payment_proofs is its own append-only table, not a column on payments, because re-uploads are the normal case and overwriting destroys dispute evidence
No customers table: guest identity is denormalised onto orders, so an order snapshots who ordered and where it shipped

Order numbers come from an order_number_seq counter using INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_val = LAST_INSERT_ID(next_val+1), inside the checkout transaction, with UNIQUE(order_number) as backstop
coupons.used_count demoted to a cache; coupon_redemptions is the source of truth for both usage_limit and the new per_phone_limit
order_items cascades from orders; every other FK off orders is SET NULL (or RESTRICT for coupon_redemptions→coupons) so catalogue deletes never touch history
admin_id columns are deliberately NOT foreign keys, paired with a snapshotted admin name, so audit rows survive staff-account deletion
Double-submit is stopped by a UNIQUE idempotency_key insert in checkout_attempts, not by disabling a button in JS
Money is DECIMAL(10,2) UNSIGNED PKR; sale_price is NULL (never 0.00) when not on sale; COALESCE(sale_price, price) is the effective price everywhere

Rounding happens exactly once, server-side, round-half-up to whole rupees, only on a percent coupon's discount; never on stored prices, line totals, subtotal, grand_total, at display time, or in the browser
Display helper money(string $value, bool $withDecimals=false) -> 'Rs.' + NBSP + thousands separator, no decimals, no rounding; money_attr() gives the bare 4950.00 form for JSON-LD

Stock guard is UPDATE product_sizes SET stock = stock - :qty WHERE id = :id AND stock >= :qty with a rowCount() === 1 check; SELECT-then-UPDATE is forbidden, and PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_FOUND_ROWS = true is banned project-wide because it would make a failed guard look like success
Isolation level READ COMMITTED (not the REPEATABLE READ default) because gap locks deadlock unrelated checkouts; safe only because no correctness decision is made from a SELECT
Deadlock prevention by total lock ordering: every transaction touches product_sizes rows in ascending id ASC order, plus a 2-attempt retry on 40001/1213

Stock restoration idempotency: orders.stock_restored is claimed and the status changed in ONE guarded UPDATE (WHERE stock_committed=1 AND stock_restored=0), so only one caller can ever win; quantities are read from the order_stock_moves ledger, not order_items

Time zone: store Asia/Karachi local wall time in DATETIME, never UTC, never TIMESTAMP — Pakistan has no DST since 2009, the client reads rows in phpMyAdmin, and Hostinger does not load MySQL time-zone tables so SET time_zone must use '+05:00'
All created_at/updated_at written from PHP, never NOW() and never a column default (functional defaults are banned for MariaDB portability)
No triggers, stored procedures, views or events — a phpMyAdmin dump restored by a non-developer must produce a working database
No sample orders are seeded: commerce tables ship empty so the first real order is order number one and dashboard revenue is true from day one

Single storefront front controller (index.php) plus a SECOND independent admin front controller at admin/index.php — the auth gate and CSRF check are one unconditional block, so a new admin page cannot forget them
Collapsed doc 03's assumed /app + /includes into app/lib/ — one denied top-level directory instead of two
Routes are a plain ordered PHP array in app/routes.php (data, not logic), with named param patterns (slug, order, num) rather than hand-written inline regex
Nine listing URLs (/shop, collection, 3 gender, scent, new, best, sale, search) share one controller and one view via a route 'preset' key — one code path, not nine
BASE_PATH constant written by install.php + three URL builders (url(), asset(), canonical()); routes.php stays root-relative and index.php strips BASE_PATH before matching
Subdirectory or non-canonical-host installs default to settings.site_indexable = 0 so staging copies cannot outrank the live shop
Payment screenshots in uploads/payments/ are served only through an authenticated admin handler, never by the /uploads rewrite pass-through
PHPMailer vendored at app/lib/vendor/PHPMailer/ (4 files + LICENSE), lazily require_once'd inside app/lib/mail.php only — not in bootstrap
Rewrite rule matches assets/ and uploads/ BEFORE the catch-all so a missing image 404s at the server instead of booting PHP and hitting the DB
abort(404) renders 404.php inside the full layout with header/footer/cart drawer; hidden or inactive records 404 rather than 403
HTTPS force uses three ANDed RewriteConds (%{HTTPS}, X-Forwarded-Proto, SERVER_PORT 443) to avoid the Hostinger edge-proxy redirect loop

No php_flag/php_value anywhere — LiteSpeed/LSAPI ignores them silently; uploads PHP execution is blocked by RemoveHandler + RemoveType + AddType text/plain + <FilesMatch> Require all denied, four independent layers

CSP keeps script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' deliberately (inline JSON-LD + inline JS, no build step to thread nonces); 'unsafe-eval' and all external script hosts excluded. style-src allows fonts.googleapis.com, font-src allows fonts.gstatic.com — both needed or fonts silently fall back to Times
HSTS deliberately omitted at launch, added after 14 verified days of valid cert; no preload
Every Require all denied is wrapped in <IfModule mod_authz_core.c> with an Order/Deny 2.2 fallback, because an unguarded directive 500s the whole site and recovery is File-Manager-only
Layer-3 guard constant: entry points define('SKYFR',1); every included file begins defined('SKYFR') || exit; — the only layer that survives a lost .htaccess
install.php writes uploads/.htaccess itself from a string literal and self-tests execution by fetching a .probe.php over HTTP, removing the dependency on the ZIP preserving a dotfile
Only uploads/ is writable (0755); config/config.php is 0600; no writable log or cache directory inside public_html
PHP ini set via hPanel PHP Configuration and a shipped .user.ini (not .htaccess); .user.ini itself denied by a root <FilesMatch>
Uploads enforced at 5MB server-side against an 8MB ini value, so an over-limit POST yields a real UPLOAD_ERR code instead of silently empty $_POST/$_FILES
Money is DECIMAL(10,2) fetched as a string; one money() helper does the only float cast, arithmetic in integer paisa — overrides 03 §1.4's 'unsigned integer rupees'
ONE CSRF token per session, not per form, so multi-tab carts and long-lived admin phone sessions do not break; rotated only on login/logout/password change
PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES=false, named placeholders only, no Db::raw(); dynamic filters build a $where array of code-literal fragments and a SORT whitelist map — no user input ever reaches SQL text

Originals are never stored: every delivered image is re-encoded from a GD resource (that is the EXIF strip); 3 sizes x WebP+JPEG, WebP gated on a probed settings flag with <source> simply omitted when GD lacks it

Email is sent AFTER the checkout transaction commits, in its own try/catch; failure writes to a new email_queue table and the order still completes — introduces email_queue as a cross-stream schema addition
install.php refuses to re-run on three independent guards and writes config.php only after a live DB connect + CREATE/DROP probe, via temp+rename
Payment proofs are served through an auth-checked /admin/proof.php streamer with random filenames, never from /uploads directly
Exactly one file differs between local and Hostinger: config.php (env, base_url, db, smtp); router.php is dev-only and excluded from the ZIP

Deferred to 07 §0.2 as the naming contract and opened §5.0 with an explicit reconciliation table (collections.sort_order not position, reviews.status='approved' not is_approved, gender values him/her/unisex), listing every extra column this doc requests rather than silently inventing names.

Filter state lives entirely in the query string with comma-separated slugs, a fixed canonical parameter order enforced by 301, and a noindex table: single-value filters indexable, multi-filter/sort/price noindex — and /shop?gender=him 301s to /for-him.

Classic LIMIT/OFFSET pagination at 24/page (no infinite scroll, no SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS, which is deprecated in MySQL 8 and differs on MariaDB); every sort ends in id DESC and is prefixed by sold-out-last.
Listing query uses one derived table over product_sizes for min price/stock/on-sale (not correlated subqueries), images fetched in a second IN() query, with six named three-column indexes.

Search uses scored LIKE, not FULLTEXT — portability between MySQL 8 and MariaDB 10.4 plus a low-hundreds catalogue; a unique SKU match redirects straight to the product; zero-result terms logged to search_queries.

Related products given an exact point-scoring rule (collection 5, family 4, shared note word 3, gender 2, price band 2, sale 1, out-of-stock −6) with fixed tie-breakers and best-seller fill to always show exactly 4.
Cart session stores only product_size_id and qty; every render and the order transaction re-price from the DB, with stated messages for removed and clamped lines.

Order placement: single-use token + transaction + UPDATE ... WHERE stock >= ? requiring rowCount()=1, so overselling fails the guard instead of writing a negative; order_number is SF-YYMM-5 random base32, never sequential.

Confirmation page is token-gated (orders.access_token) and is the full receipt; the track page is order-number + phone and deliberately shows no address, phone, payment detail or per-line price — the split is documented explicitly.
Anti-spam is honeypot + HMAC-signed time-trap + CSRF + a rate_limits table keyed on ip_hash, with no third-party captcha; honeypot/time-trap failures return success and are written to spam_log.

Self-host 5 woff2 files under /assets/fonts/ rather than using the Google Fonts CDN (no third-party DNS/TLS on the critical path, uploadable via File Manager); CDN preconnect markup documented only as fallback.

Brand gold #D4B084 on ivory computes to 1.79:1 — fails AA body, AA large and the 3:1 non-text bar. Binding rule: brand gold is a dark-context colour only; ivory contexts use derived --gold-800 #7A5A2E (5.56:1) for text and --gold-700 for borders.

Gradient gold text is governed by its worst stop (3.55:1), so it is permitted only at >=28px and never on prices, buttons, links or body; always with a flat gold-400 color fallback behind background-clip:text.
Radius is 0 everywhere except genuinely circular affordances — justified against the Le Labo / Byredo / Aesop / Diptyque squared-corner category convention and the bottle-shoulder reference.

No shadow scale on a near-black UI. Elevation = surface lightness steps inside a 20-point luminance band, plus hairline + scrim; one gold --glow-accent for the primary CTA and --shadow-light for .t-light only.

Flattened BEM with single-class selectors only (0-1-0 specificity everywhere, zero !important except the reduced-motion block), chosen over utilities (needs a build step) and descendant selectors (specificity creep).
Media queries stay inline under each component rather than grouped at the bottom, because with no build step contiguity beats byte count.
Ink ramp is warm-shifted (+6R/+5G/+4B per step) so surfaces never read blue next to champagne gold.
No prefers-color-scheme: the brand is dark; .t-light is a context class for admin, print and the ivory band.
04a-design-tokens.md does not exist yet — I defined the full --sf-* token set inline in §0.2 (colour, space, type, elevation, motion, z-index) and stated that 04a wins if it later disagrees
Focus-visible is 2px ivory outline at 2px offset, NOT gold — gold reads as decoration on this palette; form fields are the one documented exception (gold border + 3px gold halo)
Notes pyramid is rendered as an indented ordered list with a connector rail, not a triangle graphic — a real pyramid is illegible at 375px and unreadable to a screen reader
Longevity/sillage use a 5-segment div track with role=img and a text label, not <meter> (unstyleable in Safari)
Header transparent→solid and the sticky add-to-cart bar both use IntersectionObserver sentinels, not scroll listeners; .is-transparent is applied server-side to avoid first-paint flash
Modal becomes a bottom sheet at 375px; drawer is one component used for both cart (right) and mobile filters (left)
Reveal hiding lives under html.js so JS-off or JS-broken never hides content; reveals are one-way (unobserve on first intersection)
Dialog close listens for transitionend with a 400ms setTimeout guard so reduced-motion 0.01ms transitions cannot strand a trapped focus state
Checkout, cart and track pages are excluded from scroll reveal entirely
JS budget fixed at five files (reveal/ui/cart/product/forms, ~11 KB); filtering, sorting, pagination and the scent-finder quiz are full page loads with no JS
Bottom tab bar over a drawer for mobile nav — the daily loop is orders↔products and a drawer costs a tap each way; 5 slots with a context-aware centre + button
bcrypt cost 12 (not Argon2id, not cost 13) — Argon2 availability is not guaranteed on Hostinger and cost 13 is too slow on a throttled shared vCPU
Login rate limiter keyed on BOTH salted-IP-hash and username (5 fails/15min username, 10/15min IP) — IP-only is trivially bypassed on Pakistani mobile data; raw IPs are never stored

No self-service password reset: outbound mail on shared hosting is the least reliable component and the inbox would become a weaker second key; recovery is a shipped-disabled reset-password.php.disabled renamed via hPanel
60-minute idle + 12-hour absolute timeout, no remember-me — a persistent-login token table is disproportionate security code for a one-operator shop
One CSRF token per session, rotated only on login and password change, so a second tab never breaks; Origin/Referer check as a second layer that tolerates missing headers
Revenue = SUM(grand_total) over confirmed/packing/shipped/delivered — 'accepted' not 'collected', because a COD shop counting only delivered shows near-zero early each month
Orders CSV is one row per order (not per line item) with items flattened, so totals sum correctly in Excel; capped at 5,000 rows per request
CSV files carry a UTF-8 BOM (opposite of seed.sql, which must be BOM-less) and prefix any field starting = + - @ TAB CR with an apostrophe
Low stock is per-size with a per-size override over a global default of 5; the low state is never shown to customers — no 'only 2 left' urgency copy
Admin cannot author or edit reviews, cannot touch historical order prices/totals, cannot decrement used_count, cannot hard-delete a product that appears on an order
orders.status and orders.payment_status are separate columns — a COD order can be delivered+unpaid, a bank order paid+pending
delivered and cancelled are terminal and irreversible; the only backward steps are packing→confirmed and shipped→packing, both requiring a reason
Stock is decremented once at checkout and only ever returned by cancellation; restore is guarded by orders.stock_restored_at plus an AND stock_restored_at IS NULL on the commit UPDATE
Payment proofs are stored outside public_html, re-encoded through GD at upload, and served only by an authenticated PHP streaming endpoint with nosniff + a locked CSP; no public URL exists
Mark-as-paid changes nothing but payment_status/paid_at — no status change, no email, no stock
order_items and all money columns are frozen forever; a changed order is a new order
No PDF library — invoice and packing slip are HTML + @media print with an 80mm thermal rule; packing slip prints no prices except the COD collect banner
Followed DECIMAL(10,2) over 03-storefront-pages.md §1.4's unsigned-integer rupees, and flagged the conflict inline
Orders are never deletable; cancellation is a state
No cron is assumed — unpaid manual-payment orders are flagged, never auto-cancelled

Cart lives in the PHP session, not a DB table — guest-only checkout makes a DB cart no more durable than the session cookie, and the cart stores no prices so there is nothing valuable to persist; session lifetime raised to 3 days with an app-owned session save path so the host's GC cannot sweep carts early
Cart is keyed by product_sizes.id (the sellable unit, each with its own price/stock), one line per size_id, storing only {size_id, qty} plus a coupon CODE string and updated_at
DECIMAL(10,2) wins over doc 03's 'unsigned integer whole rupees'; all PHP arithmetic is done in integer paisa, converted at the boundary, floats never touch money

Rounding happens in exactly one place: the percent-coupon discount, rounded half-up to the whole rupee (in the customer's favour on a tie). Line totals, subtotal, shipping and grand total are exact integer arithmetic and must NOT be rounded
Percent coupons never touch shipping (shipping is a real courier cost); fixed coupons clamp to the subtotal; the total cannot go below zero structurally, plus an assertion at placement
Coupons do NOT stack — the session holds a single code, and applying a second REPLACES the first with a friendly 'X was replaced by Y' message rather than an error
Free-shipping threshold is tested against the PRE-discount subtotal, so applying a coupon can never re-add the shipping fee and the progress bar stays monotonic
Progress bar uses floor() not round() so it never reads 100% while a fee is still charged; hidden on the checkout page
Flat nationwide shipping fee — no city-based rates; city is captured for the courier only and affects no number
A coupon that becomes invalid is dropped and re-priced on every render; at checkout POST the transaction is rolled back and NO order is written — the customer must re-confirm the new total
A price change between add-to-cart and checkout rolls back placement and shows an explicit before/after notice; a price DROP is treated identically to a rise
Added an HMAC re-price token — not a trusted price, purely a detector for 'the total the customer agreed to is not the total I computed'
Money columns are DECIMAL(10,2), resolving a direct conflict with 03-storefront-pages.md §1.4 which says unsigned integer rupees — doc 03 must be amended.

Order storage schema (orders, order_items, order_status_history, order_payment_proofs, coupon_redemptions, email_outbox, rate_limits) is defined here as a NEW cross-stream contract because neither 03 nor 07 §0.2 covers it; the schema stream wins if it has already named these.
Idempotency is the UNIQUE index on orders.idempotency_key — the order row is its own idempotency record; a duplicate-key catch redirects to the existing order.

READ COMMITTED at checkout only, plus ascending-product_size_id lock ordering and a 2-retry deadlock loop; correctness rests on the conditional UPDATE ... AND stock >= :qty, not on the isolation level.
Coupon limit is enforced by UPDATE coupons SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE ... used_count < usage_limit inside the transaction; rowCount()==0 rolls everything back.
Order number is SF-YYMMDD-<4 random base32> (non-sequential) and the confirmation page is gated by a 32-hex access_token.
Phone is stored plaintext for the admin plus an HMAC phone_hash (normalised to last 10 digits) used for every lookup, rate limit and coupon-per-phone guard.
Email uses vendored PHPMailer over SMTP with an email_outbox queue: queue first, attempt once in-request with an 8s timeout, swallow all failures, drain by cron with exponential backoff.
Coupon/stock/product-deactivation failures are recoverable re-renders with a specific message, never hard errors; only stock and coupon failures roll back a transaction.

Payment proof accepts JPG/PNG/WEBP/PDF up to 5MB, MIME verified with finfo on the temp file, random 64-hex filename, stored outside public_html (hardened .htaccess fallback), served only through an admin-authenticated readfile endpoint.
Coupon redeemability is DERIVED, never stored — is_active means the owner switched it off; expired/exhausted coupons stay is_active=1 so the admin list shows real states
Check order in coupon_state is the message order: expired beats below-minimum, so a customer is never told to add items for a dead code
expires_at stored as 23:59:59 Asia/Karachi, else every coupon dies a day early
is_sample TINYINT column on every seeded content table is the single mechanism enabling a safe one-shot sample-data purge; the purge refuses to delete products that have been ordered
Payment account details seed as literal 'REPLACE ME' strings, treated as unset: dashboard red banner + checkout hides that method + COD force-enabled if all manual methods are unconfigured
aggregateRating JSON-LD emitted ONLY from real approved reviews; absent otherwise, never defaulted or borrowed
JSON-LD prices come from the same effective_price() helper as the visible price; AggregateOffer for multi-size, Offer for single
sitemap.xml is generated by sitemap.php with a 1-hour file cache, not a static file a non-developer would never regenerate
robots.txt Disallows /*?page= and /*?sort= ; filtered listings are noindex and the preset landings (/for-him, /scent/{slug}) are the indexable versions
Critical CSS is a deploy-time slice of the single stylesheet at comment banners (14KB budget), inlined; full sheet preloaded; ?v={filemtime} busts cache automatically
Self-hosted woff2 fonts, exactly two preloaded faces; zero third-party JS at launch; site fully functional with JS disabled

Uploads: type from finfo+getimagesize, random hex filename from detected MIME, re-encoded through GD so original bytes never hit disk; payment proofs served only via an admin-session PHP streamer, never from /uploads
Uploads .htaccess uses three independent guards (FilesMatch deny, RemoveHandler, AddType text/plain) because php_flag engine off does not work under FastCGI on Hostinger
Stock safety is the `AND stock >= ?` guard on the UPDATE plus ascending-id row locking in one transaction; UNSIGNED column; cancel is idempotent
PII: track requires order number + phone, order numbers are non-sequential SKY-YYYYMM-6rand, CSV cells starting = + - @ are prefixed, payment proofs deleted 90 days after delivered/cancelled
openQuestions: 03-storefront-pages.md §1.4 still says prices are unsigned integer whole rupees — that line needs amending to DECIMAL(10,2) to match this document and 07 §0.2.
The commerce-half document must confirm order_items references product_size_id (and snapshots name/SKU/price at order time), since the soft-delete policy here depends on that reference existing.
settings key list is code-owned in /includes/settings-defaults.php; whichever stream owns the admin Settings screen must publish the full key list and setting_group assignment.
admin_users.role 'staff' is defined but never granted in v1 — the commerce doc needs to define what a staff account may do before it is issued.
Low-stock threshold is read from settings.low_stock_threshold; the dashboard spec should confirm that key name.

The admins table lives in another stream — order_status_history.admin_id, payments.verified_by and order_notes.admin_id reference it by value only, so that stream must confirm INT UNSIGNED ids and a username ≤60 chars
cod_fee is specified but fixed at 0.00 in v1; confirm the client never wants a COD surcharge before the settings stream omits the key
Partial payments are out of scope (UNIQUE on payments.order_id). If layaway/advance payments are ever wanted, that unique key must be dropped first
Rate limiting for track-order reuses the admin_login_attempts shape; the security stream should decide whether that is one shared table or a second one
01a-schema-catalogue.md and 01b-schema-commerce.md do not exist yet — if 01b picks different commerce table names, 01b wins on names and this document wins on behaviour
Doc 03 §16 'Data contract' is referenced from 03 §1 but the section is absent from the file; the storefront's full column requirements could not be cross-checked
03 §1.4's integer-rupee claim needs an explicit edit by whoever owns 03
The gender preset mismatch (men/women vs him/her) needs one owner to settle it in 03's route table

Money representation conflicts across streams: 07 §0.2 says DECIMAL(10,2) PKR (and the task brief agrees), but 03 §1.4 says prices are stored as unsigned integers in whole rupees. The schema stream must settle this; app/lib/money.php is written against DECIMAL(10,2).

07 §0.2 defines products.gender as him|her|unisex while 03 §2 route presets say gender=men/women/unisex. This document uses him|her|unisex per the schema contract — the storefront doc needs correcting.
Order number format is assumed to be SF-###### (6-10 digits) for the {order} route pattern; the orders schema must confirm.
The orders/order_items/contact_messages/newsletter_subscribers/pages/admin_users tables are used by routes here but are not in the 07 §0.2 contract list — the schema stream should publish them.
settings.site_indexable is a new key this document requires; it needs adding to the settings seed and to the admin Settings screen.
ASSET_VERSION bumping is manual (no build step) — needs a documented step in the go-live guide so the client's browser does not serve stale CSS after an update.
Does /contact actually ship a Google Maps embed? If doc 03 drops it, frame-src https://www.google.com should be removed from the CSP
Is Google Analytics in scope? If not, drop https://www.google-analytics.com from img-src
Doc 03 §1.1 names /app and /includes; doc 07 does not name a folder layout — doc 01 needs to confirm the five denied directory names before the Layer-1 .htaccess list is final
Confirm the Hostinger plan tier (Premium vs Business) to fix memory_limit at 256M vs 384M in .user.ini
Doc 03 §1.4 says prices are unsigned integers in whole rupees while the task brief and doc 07 §0.2 say DECIMAL(10,2) — the schema stream must resolve this; nothing in this document depends on it
Doc 03 §1.4 (integer rupees) must be amended to DECIMAL(10,2) — needs the schema stream's sign-off
Hostinger SMTP host/port (assumed smtp.hostinger.com:587 TLS) must be confirmed in hPanel at deploy time
Is hPanel cron available on the client's plan? The email_queue drain is optional by design but retry is manual without it
Doc 03 puts /app, /includes, /storage under public_html for File-Manager reasons; if the plan actually exposes a parent directory, /storage/logs should move above the webroot
Regenerate-derivatives re-derives from the zoom image because originals are discarded — confirm the client accepts that trade rather than doubling storage

The file exceeds the harness's ~550-line soft cap (810 lines) because all nine assigned items needed coverage; say the word and I will split it into 02c-a (bootstrap/data/views) and 02c-b (images/mail/install/ops)
The appended document is roughly 1,350 lines against the harness's ~550-line guidance; if the length matters more than the depth, §5.10, §16 and §18 are the sections that compress most cleanly.
The route table in §2 (pre-existing) writes the gender preset as gender=men/women while the schema contract uses him/her; §5.0 records the mapping, but §2 should be corrected at the source.
§4.9 (pre-existing) reads reviews.is_approved and reviews.is_verified; the first needs changing to status = 'approved', the second is a requested addition.

Free shipping is flat nationwide in v1; per-city rates are deferred to §17 and would change §8.3 and §7.5.
cities is seeded with ~40 major cities — the exact list is not enumerated here and should live with the seed in doc 07.
Document ran to 852 lines against the harness's ~550 cap — sections 4-6 were required by the assignment and could not be cut further without dropping specified content. Trim if the cap is hard.

Font weights were decided (Cormorant 300/400, Jost 300/400/500) without a visual proof; the 118 KB budget assumes Latin-subset woff2 at typical Google Fonts sizes and should be verified against the actual downloaded files.
The .t-light context is specified here but the admin stream has not confirmed it will consume it rather than defining its own palette.
Whether the client wants a light-on-ivory 'Why Choose Us' band at all — it is assumed here as the only storefront use of .t-light.
Motion specifics (scroll reveal thresholds, hover zoom amounts) are only tokenised here; the component stream still owns the actual transitions.
04a-design-tokens.md has not been written — if that stream picks different token names or hex values, §0.2 of 04b must be reconciled to it

03-storefront-pages.md §1.4 says prices are stored as unsigned integers in whole rupees, but the brief and 07-seed-seo-quality.md §0.2 say DECIMAL(10,2). I followed DECIMAL(10,2); the schema stream must settle this
03 uses gender preset values gender=men/women in the route table while 07 §0.2 defines products.gender as him|her|unisex — the listing controller needs an explicit mapping or one side must change

Cormorant Garamond and Jost are specified with no Google Fonts JS and no build step — the font delivery method (self-hosted woff2 in /assets/fonts with a hand-written @font-face block and font-display:swap) is assumed here but owned by the CSS/asset stream

## OUTPUT PROTOCOL — READ THIS FIRST, IT IS MANDATORY

A previous run of this task was KILLED because agents composed one huge document and emitted
it in a single enormous tool call, producing no activity for minutes. You must not repeat that.

Rules:
1. Write your document with Bash heredoc APPENDS, not the Write tool:
   cat >> "<your file>" <<'SFEOF'
   ...content...
